learningPaths.title: Personal Finance Foundations and Wealth Architecture
learningPaths.targetAudience: Beginners, salaried professionals, young adults starting their financial journeys

curriculumStages.stageName: Cash Flow and Balance Sheet Mastery
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Construct an exhaustive personal balance sheet listing liquid, invested, and tangible assets against outstanding debts.

curriculumStages.stageName: Time Value of Money and Real Returns
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Calculate the real purchasing power of your current savings goal across a 20-year horizon at 7% inflation.

curriculumStages.stageName: Emergency Reserves and Liquidity Buffers
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Size a multi-tier contingency reserve covering 6 months of mandatory fixed expenses and loan EMIs.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: A fully engineered personal balance sheet, optimized cashflow allocation, and a funded multi-tier emergency liquidity reserve.

learningPaths.title: Indian Banking Safety and Credit Management
learningPaths.targetAudience: Bank depositors, credit card users, prospective home loan borrowers

curriculumStages.stageName: Deposit Insurance and Bank Solvency
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Audit all family bank deposit holdings across branches and ownership capacities to ensure zero uninsured balance exposure.

curriculumStages.stageName: Credit Score Optimization and Debt Amortization
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Download your official CIBIL credit report, audit tradelines for clerical reporting errors, and model loan prepayment savings.

curriculumStages.stageName: Consumer Protection and Dispute Redressal
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Map the 3-tier statutory escalation pathway from bank nodal officer to the RBI Integrated Ombudsman for disputed digital debits.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Complete deposit safety architecture and an optimized CIBIL score exceeding 770 with optimized debt prepayment.

learningPaths.title: Mutual Funds, ETFs and Passive Indexing
learningPaths.targetAudience: Retail investors, salaried wealth builders, long-term compounders

curriculumStages.stageName: SEBI Categorization and Scheme Plumbing
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Audit your mutual fund portfolio to convert all Regular plans to Direct plans, eliminating distributor commission drag.

curriculumStages.stageName: Passive Indexing and ETF Liquidity
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Compare tracking difference and market maker bid-ask spreads between a Nifty 50 Index Fund and a Nifty 50 ETF.

curriculumStages.stageName: Systematic Wealth Accumulation
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Model a 10% annual step-up SIP across a 15-year compounding horizon.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: A low-cost, diversified multi-asset mutual fund portfolio with zero distributor commission leakage.

learningPaths.title: Fixed Income, Sovereign Debt and Yield Dynamics

curriculumStages.stageName: Sovereign Debt and RBI Retail Direct
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Open and navigate the RBI Retail Direct portal to inspect primary sovereign treasury bill and G-Sec auction pricing.

curriculumStages.stageName: Duration, Convexity and Interest Rate Sensitivity
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Calculate the price drop on an 8-year duration bond fund if the RBI Monetary Policy Committee hikes the repo rate by 50 basis points.

curriculumStages.stageName: Tax-Equivalent Yields and Corporate Debt
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Evaluate whether an 8.5% taxable corporate bond beats a 7.1% tax-exempt PPF deposit for a 30% tax bracket investor.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Mastery over interest rate cycles, duration risk quantification, and sovereign G-Sec direct investing.

learningPaths.title: Indian Direct Taxation and Compliance Architecture
learningPaths.targetAudience: Salaried taxpayers, freelancers, software engineers, active investors

curriculumStages.stageName: New vs Old Tax Regime Optimization
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Calculate your exact deductions and determine whether the Old or New Regime yields higher net take-home salary.

curriculumStages.stageName: Capital Gains Post-Finance Act 2024
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Audit investment sales to accurately apply the 20% STCG and 12.5% LTCG rates and Section 112A ₹1.25 Lakh exemption.

curriculumStages.stageName: Advance Tax and Statutory Compliance
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Map the 4 quarterly advance tax deadlines and compute Section 234C interest liability for deferred tax installments.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Full mastery of Section 115BAC optimizations, capital gains tax reporting, and zero statutory interest penalties under Sections 234ABC.

learningPaths.title: Insurance Underwriting, Health Policies and Asset Shielding
learningPaths.targetAudience: Family breadwinners, young parents, business founders

curriculumStages.stageName: Pure Term Insurance and MWP Act Trusts
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Size your life insurance requirement using human capital present value, and structure policy under MWP Act Section 6.

curriculumStages.stageName: Health Insurance and Room-Rent Trap Mitigation
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Review health policy wording to identify room rent sub-limits, proportionate deductions, and synchronize a super top-up deductible.

curriculumStages.stageName: Claim Disputes and Insurance Ombudsman
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Draft a formal claim escalation notice citing Section 45 incontestability jurisprudence for a delayed claim.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Unimpeachable pure term cover ring-fenced from creditors, comprehensive health indemnity with zero sub-limits, and dispute escalation readiness.

learningPaths.title: Retirement Corpus Sizing, NPS and Decumulation Engineering
learningPaths.targetAudience: Pre-retirees, Financial Independence Retire Early (FIRE) seekers, wealth planners

curriculumStages.stageName: Retirement Corpus Mathematical Sizing
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Model your 30-year retirement corpus requirement factoring in pre-retirement and post-retirement inflation.

curriculumStages.stageName: NPS, EPF and Pension Instrument Plumbing
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Optimize NPS Tier I asset allocation between equity (E) and corporate bonds (C) and analyze mandatory 40% annuity taxation.

curriculumStages.stageName: Safe Withdrawal Rates and SWP Decumulation
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Simulate a 3.5% initial Safe Withdrawal Rate with annual inflation step-up to stress test against early negative returns.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: An inflation-proof retirement decumulation roadmap engineered to survive 35+ years of sequence-of-returns volatility.

learningPaths.title: Real Estate Title Verification, Circle Rates and RERA Due Diligence
learningPaths.targetAudience: Property buyers, land investors, homeowners, commercial landlords

curriculumStages.stageName: Title Due Diligence and Encumbrance Search
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Conduct a mock 30-year title verification tracing mutation registers, patta/khata certificates, and sub-registrar encumbrance dockets.

curriculumStages.stageName: Circle Rates, Cash Penalties and Section 50C
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Verify that your agreement consideration complies with Section 50C safe-harbor tolerance and Section 269SS/ST banking channel rules.

curriculumStages.stageName: Rental Yield Economics and Buy vs Rent
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Calculate the true net operating yield of a residential property after municipal taxes, society maintenance, and vacancy drag.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Flawless real estate conveyancing due-diligence capabilities, circle rate tax compliance, and multi-decadal Buy vs Rent financial models.

learningPaths.title: Financial Fraud, Shadow Economy Realities and Anti-Black-Money Laws
learningPaths.targetAudience: All citizens, property buyers, high-net-worth investors, forensic accountants

curriculumStages.stageName: Real Estate Black Money, Cash Limits and Penalties
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Analyze the devastating 100% monetary penalty consequences of Section 271D on buyers coerced into cash property advances.

curriculumStages.stageName: Benami Property Forfeiture and Prosecution
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Inspect PBPT Act statutory provisions on absolute asset forfeiture without compensation and 7-year prison terms.

curriculumStages.stageName: Dabba Trading, Ponzi Schemes and Cyber Fraud
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Examine SCRA Section 23 criminal sanctions against bucket shops, and test National Cybercrime Portal 1930 lien-freezing protocols.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Deep forensic awareness of shadow economy traps, anti-money-laundering enforcement powers (ED/ITD), and total immunity against illegal financial schemes.

learningPaths.title: Estate Planning, Wills, Probate and Trust Structuring
learningPaths.targetAudience: Parents, business owners, estate executors, testators

curriculumStages.stageName: Nomination vs Legal Heirship Jurisprudence
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Reconcile all banking, insurance, and demat account nominations with a formal testamentary Will.

curriculumStages.stageName: Will Drafting and Mandatory Probate Architecture
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Draft an unambiguous Will with clear residuary clauses, two independent attesting witnesses, and probate compliance for metro properties.

curriculumStages.stageName: Private Family Trusts and Asset Protection
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Design an irrevocable discretionary family trust structure to insulate assets from business liabilities and marital disputes.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: A legally sound estate transmission plan aligning nominations, testamentary Wills, and private trust asset protection.

learningPaths.title: Exchange Derivatives, Option Greeks and Quantitative Risk
learningPaths.targetAudience: Active traders, derivatives analysts, quantitative finance students

curriculumStages.stageName: Futures, Options and Margining Architecture
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Inspect SPAN and Peak Margin requirements on index futures contracts across varying volatility regimes.

curriculumStages.stageName: Option Greeks and Theta Decay Mechanics
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Model the non-linear Theta decay curve of a weekly Nifty call option during the final 48 hours before expiry.

curriculumStages.stageName: SEBI Retail Loss Evidence and Risk Management
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Analyze SEBI's empirical research demonstrating 93% retail F&O net losses and structure defined-risk hedged spreads.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Quantitative comprehension of option sensitivity Greeks, margin systems, and risk-managed hedging techniques.

learningPaths.title: Quantitative Portfolio Management and Factor Investing
learningPaths.targetAudience: Advanced investors, wealth managers, quantitative portfolio constructors

curriculumStages.stageName: Modern Portfolio Theory and Asset Allocation
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Construct an efficient frontier using historical covariance matrices between Indian equities, G-Secs, and gold.

curriculumStages.stageName: Factor Investing Premiums in India
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Backtest the performance of Nifty 200 Momentum 30 and Nifty Quality 30 indices against the broad market over 15 years.

curriculumStages.stageName: Risk-Adjusted Ratios and Rebalancing Bands
curriculumStages.practicalExercise: Calculate Sharpe and Sortino ratios for a multi-asset portfolio and model tax-friction rebalancing bands.

learningPaths.milestoneOutcome: Mastery of quantitative factor investing, risk-adjusted performance ratios, and optimal multi-asset rebalancing protocols.
